map.CPK 过程能力指数 使用指南: CPK Process Capability Index User Guide
map.输入规格上下限、样本均值与标准差，计算制程能力指数CPK（合格线≥1.33），评: Enter the upper and lower specification limits, the sample mean and the standard deviation to compute the process capability index CPK (1.33 or above is acceptable), assessing whether the process meets quality and stability requirements.
map.来料或过程质量判定时，用 CPK/CP 评估过程能力是否满足规格，决定接收或调整: When judging incoming or in-process quality, use CPK/CP to assess whether process capability meets the specification, deciding to accept or to adjust the process.
map.过程居中性核查时，用 CA 偏移系数判断均值是否偏离公差中心，指导设备/参数调校: When checking whether the process is centered, use the CA shift factor to judge whether the mean has drifted from the center of the tolerance and guide equipment or parameter tuning.
map.长期稳定性监控时，用 PPK（长期）与 CPK（短期）对比，识别随时间漂移的特殊: For long-term stability monitoring, compare PPK (long term) with CPK (short term) to identify special causes that drift over time.
map.：某轴径规格 9.5–10.5mm、实测均值 10.0mm、标准差 0.1mm、: A shaft diameter specification of 9.5-10.5mm has a measured mean of 10.0mm, a standard deviation of 0.1mm and 30 samples. Tolerance T = 10.5 - 9.5 = 1.0mm; CP = 1.0/(6*0.1) = 1.67; CPU = (10.5 - 10.0)/(3*0.1) = 1.67, CPL = (10.0 - 9.5)/0.3 = 1.67, CPK = min = 1.67; the tolerance center is 10.0mm, CA = |10.0 - 10.0|/(1.0/2) = 0% (centered, no shift); the long-term PPK corrected for sample size is about 1.66. Conclusion: CPK >= 1.33 means capability is acceptable and well centered.
map.CPK 和 CP 有什么不同？: What's the Difference Between CPK and CP?
map.CP 只看公差宽度与过程离散度（潜力），不考虑均值偏移；CPK = min(CP: CP looks only at tolerance width and process spread (potential) and ignores mean shift; CPK = min(CPU, CPL) accounts for the shift as well and reflects real capability better. When the mean is centered, CPK = CP; the larger the shift, the smaller CPK.
map.一般工业：CPK≥1.33 合格（推荐），≥1.67 能力过剩可放宽公差，1.0: General industry: CPK >= 1.33 is acceptable (recommended), >= 1.67 means capacity is overabundant and tolerances can be relaxed, 1.0-1.33 is borderline and needs improvement, < 1.0 is insufficient. Automotive and similar industries often require >= 1.33 or even >= 1.67.
map.→ 打开CPK 过程能力指数工具: → Open the Quality Control (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.输入规格上下限、样本均值与标准差，计算制程能力指数CPK（合格线≥1.33），评: Enter specification limits, sample mean and standard deviation to compute CPK (acceptance line ≥ 1.33) and assess whether capability meets the specification; this does not replace a control-chart stability judgment.
map.长期波动对比时，用 PPK（长期 σ）与 CPK（短期 σ）的差距提示漂移风险；: When comparing long-term variation, the gap between PPK (long-term sigma) and CPK (short-term sigma) flags drift risk; capability indices alone cannot prove stability, which requires a control chart or time series.
map.：某轴径规格 9.5–10.5mm、实测均值 10.0mm、标准差 0.1mm、: : A shaft diameter has limits 9.5–10.5 mm, measured mean 10.0 mm, standard deviation 0.1 mm and 30 samples. Tolerance T = 10.5 − 9.5 = 1.0 mm; CP = 1.0 ÷ (6 × 0.1) = 1.67; CPU = (10.5 − 10.0) ÷ (3 × 0.1) = 1.67, CPL = (10.0 − 9.5) ÷ 0.3 = 1.67, CPK = min = 1.67; tolerance center 10.0 mm, CA = |10.0 − 10.0| ÷ (1.0 ÷ 2) = 0% (well centered); if long-term/overall sigma 0.12 mm is also entered (20% above short-term sigma), PPK = 1.0 ÷ (6 × 0.12) = 1.389; with no long-term sigma the page does not compute PPK (it does not substitute short-term sigma). Theoretical yield under normality, an unchanged mean and two-sided limits is about 99.99966% (DPMO ≈ 3.4), a model result for this specific sigma/mean, not a universal conversion that “CPK ≥ 1.67 means 6 sigma yield”; selecting the 1.5 sigma upward shift lowers the yield noticeably. Conclusion: CPK ≥ 1.33 is capable and well centered, but the 30-sample interval is still wide and stability must be checked with a control chart.
map.理论良率 99.99% 就是 6σ 吗？1.5σ 漂移怎么处理？: Is a 99.99% theoretical yield the same as 6 sigma? How is the 1.5 sigma shift handled?
map.不是。良率由本页输入的均值、短期 σ 与规格按正态分布积分得到；是否采用 1.5: No. Yield is integrated from the entered mean, short-term sigma and limits under normality; whether to apply the 1.5 sigma shift is chosen under “Yield basis”; the default does not shift, and selecting “Apply 1.5 sigma shift” moves the mean up 1.5 sigma before computing. The familiar 3.4 DPMO is the “long-term with 1.5 sigma shift” convention, so a yield above 99.99% alone does not justify calling it 6 sigma.
map.样本数 n 会改变 CPK 吗？: Does sample size n change CPK?
map.不会改变 CPK 点估计，但会影响估计不确定性。本页给出 CPK 的 95% 近: It does not change the CPK point estimate but affects estimation uncertainty. The page shows an approximate 95% CPK interval; the smaller n, the wider the interval. PPK also shows a low-sample caveat when n < 30. To judge stability, use consecutive subgroups, a control chart and time series rather than CPK alone.
